conflict_flags.rationale: BFA project numbering convention YY-NNN (e.g., 22-051) is consistent with BFA's standard format. The number '20188-04' in the SEIR header appears to be a different referencing system — possibly a task order or client-side tracking number. Using 22-051 as the BFA internal project number and documenting 20188-04 as an alternative reference.
